strikes.name: Light Air Strike
strikes.effect: Declare in the Ranged Attack Phase. Hit: 2 groups of 5 on the target, 12 hits the rear. Miss: no effect.

strikes.name: Light Bombing
strikes.effect: Hit: 3 AE groups in the target hex. Miss: scatters 1 hex per point missed; hits whatever is there. Buildings: all inside take full damage.

strikes.name: Heavy Air Strike
strikes.effect: Declare in the Ranged Attack Phase. Hit: 4 groups of 5 on the target, 12 hits the rear. Miss: no effect.

strikes.name: Heavy Bombing
strikes.effect: Hit: 6 AE groups in the target hex. Miss: scatters 1 hex per point missed; hits whatever is there. Buildings: all inside take full damage.

strikes.name: Strafing
strikes.effect: Pick up to 5 hexes in a straight line. Roll for every unit there, friend or foe; each hit takes 3 groups.

strikes.name: Bluff
strikes.effect: Played face down like an air attack. When revealed nothing happens; discard it. Any air cover spent on it is wasted.

strikes.name: Light Air Cover
strikes.effect: After enemy air attacks are declared, assign to one and roll. Meet the number for that attack type and it's cancelled.

strikes.name: Heavy Air Cover
strikes.effect: After enemy air attacks are declared, assign to one and roll. Meet the number for that attack type and it's cancelled.

strikes.name: Arrow IV
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Target hex takes the first number, adjacent hexes the second. Miss: scatters.

strikes.name: Thumper
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Target hex takes the first number, adjacent hexes the second. Miss: scatters.

strikes.name: Sniper
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Target hex takes the first number, adjacent hexes the second. Miss: scatters.

strikes.name: Long Tom
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Damage drops each ring out: target, adjacent, 2 hexes. Miss: scatters.

strikes.name: Copperhead (Thumper)
strikes.effect: Guided shell. Only targets a unit hit by friendly TAG this turn; no LOS needed. Hits on 4+ like Arrow IV homing.

strikes.name: Copperhead (Sniper)
strikes.effect: Guided shell. Only targets a unit hit by friendly TAG this turn; no LOS needed. Hits on 4+ like Arrow IV homing.

strikes.name: Copperhead (Long Tom)
strikes.effect: Guided shell. Only targets a unit hit by friendly TAG this turn; no LOS needed. Hits on 4+ like Arrow IV homing.

strikes.name: Smoke (Arrow IV)
strikes.effect: Lands next turn. Target and adjacent hexes fill with smoke, no damage. Heavy, 2 levels; light at end of next turn, gone a turn later.

strikes.name: Smoke (Thumper)
strikes.effect: Lands next turn. Only the target hex fills with smoke, no damage. Heavy, 2 levels; light at end of next turn, gone a turn later.

strikes.name: Smoke (Sniper)
strikes.effect: Lands next turn. Target and adjacent hexes fill with smoke, no damage. Heavy, 2 levels; light at end of next turn, gone a turn later.

strikes.name: Smoke (Long Tom)
strikes.effect: Lands next turn. Hexes out to 2 away fill with smoke, no damage. Heavy, 2 levels; light at end of next turn, gone a turn later.

strikes.name: Light Density Minefield
strikes.effect: Secretly written down before deployment. A unit entering rolls vs TN: on a hit it takes the groups and the field loses 1 group.

strikes.name: Medium Density Minefield
strikes.effect: Secretly written down before deployment. A unit entering rolls vs TN: on a hit it takes the groups and the field loses 1 group.

strikes.name: Heavy Density Minefield
strikes.effect: Secretly written down before deployment. A unit entering rolls vs TN: on a hit it takes the groups and the field loses 1 group.
